title: Pro-zero cone of the normalized finite scalar pullback tower map
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E,L$ finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, $\iota:E\to L$ a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding, and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes. Let $P$ be an unbounded termwise-flat K-flat complex of completed $E$-coefficient module sheaves [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. Write $\mathcal O_F$ for the valuation ring of $F$, $\varpi_F$ for its chosen uniformizer and $A_{F,r}=\mathcal O_F/(\varpi_F^r)$ for $r\ge1$, with the corresponding constant finite sheaves and completed inverse limit $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,-}$. Put $C_n=\operatorname{Res}_n f^*(P\otimes A_{E,n+1})\otimes_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{L,X}$ and $D_n=\operatorname{Res}_n f^*((P\otimes_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{L,Y})\otimes A_{L,n+1})$, with the strict transitions of that node and ordinary scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension, lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. Suppose $\alpha:C_\bullet\to D_\bullet$ is a strict tower map whose degree $i$ component, on every $V\in Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and section $x\in P^i(V)$, sends $1\otimes f^*(1\otimes x)$ to $f^*(1\otimes(1\otimes x))$. Regard $\alpha$ as a map of complexes of strict towers by the degreewise rearrangement [def-pur-principal-koszul-quotient-towers], and form its mapping cone $Z$. For every $n\in\mathbf N$ there exist $m\ge n$ such that the transition $Z_m\to Z_n$ is nullhomotopic as a map of complexes of completed $L$-coefficient module sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary finite scalar pullback transition factorization to the normalized tower map. For each n it supplies m≥n and b:D_m→C_n with both triangle identities. This step involves only ordinary tensors and quotient maps and does not need the good-complex hypothesis.

Rearrange the towers degreewise by koszulTowerComplexMap. The two triangle identities give the component equations for diagonalConeTransitionHomotopy. Its explicit off-diagonal homotopy is a homotopy of the exact cone transition in the statement, without any replacement cone or localization.

theorem integralScalarPullbackConeProZero {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (hP : integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y P)
    (α : ((integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E f).obj P) ⋙
        (integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⟶
      (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l L f).obj
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (hα :
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (V : Y.ProEt)
        (x : (P.X i).val.obj (op V)),
        ((α.app (op n)).f i).val.app (op ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V))
          (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι X
            (((integralOperationsPullbackLevel.{u, u} l E f n).obj P).X i)
            (op ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V)) 1
            (integralOperationsPullbackGenerator.{u, u} l E f n
              (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex.{u, u} l E Y n).obj P).X i) V
              (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection.{u, u} l E Y n (P.X i) (op V) 1 x))) =
        integralOperationsPullbackGenerator.{u, u} l L f n
          (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex.{u, u} l L Y n).obj
            (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)).X i) V
          (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection.{u, u} l L Y n
            ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).obj (P.X i)) (op V) 1
            (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι Y (P.X i) (op V) 1 x))) :
    letI : EssentiallySmall.{u+1} X.ProEt := essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u+1} _
    letI : HasSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        AddCommGrpCat.{u+1} := integralCoefficientAbSheafify.{u, u} X
    letI : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology X).WEqualsLocallyBijective
        AddCommGrpCat.{u+1} := integralCoefficientAbLocallyBijective.{u, u} X
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      Nonempty (Homotopy (V := integralTowerModules.{u, u} l L X)
        ((CochainComplex.mappingCone (C := ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ integralTowerModules.{u, u} l L X)
          (@koszulTowerComplexMap.{u+1, u, u+1} X.ProEt inferInstance
            (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
            (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u+1} _)
            (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l L X) _ _ α)).asFunctor.map
            (homOfLE h).op) 0)
